source.title: Seal the Deal
source.objective: Collect Remnants of Valor within Naxxramas.
source.progress:
Truthfully, <name>, there may be a way to improve the power of your seal.

When we purify the remains of powerful lieutenants of the Scourge, a small amount of holy energy is not only retained, but tempered. This energy can be forged into strength.

Venture deeper inside Naxxramas, hero, and retrieve remnants of these Scourge lieutenants for me. In turn, I can empower your seal.
source.completion:
You've done well in bringing these to me, <name>.

I wonder how many of these came from our fallen brethren? Were they still in there, somewhere? I have to believe that they'd want us to prevent others from becoming like them. A small comfort, perhaps.

Allow me to empower your seal.
